decision_cruda.rationale: Both radio and CMMS agree on the LH-02 and LH-03 failures, so the confirmation rule does not apply. LH-10 is idle at the workshop and 0.29 h from C564-03. That stope has 241 t at 9.6 g/t, about 9.3 oz/h for an LH410. Central has room in its stockpile (228 of 450 t) and trucks at 91 t/h against inflow of 78 t/h plus 30 t/h from the loan. LH-03 is not back until 13:30-15:30 at the earliest. LH-08 comes off the preparacion heading, which costs 1.3 oz/h, and goes to E569-07, 0.52 h away. That stope has 164 t at 10.5 g/t, about 9.3 oz/h, and Este has no truck constraint. Net is about 8 oz/h for roughly 5-6 h. I leave LH-09 on the critical-path heading, which is worth 4.2 oz/h. Reserves cannot be activated because no stope is stopped. The estimate of 60 oz is rough. Once a loader is repaired it takes over from the loan, so the gain from each loan is mainly the hours before the repair.
